name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
short: Google's 1M-context multimodal workhorse for high-throughput input processing; shutdown scheduled, superseded by 3.6 Flash.
modalities: Text, image, audio, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio with standard rate limits (NOT on OpenCode Zen: Zen's Gemini catalogue starts at Gemini 3 Flash and carries no Gemini 2.5 route)
standout: The high-throughput multimodal workhorse of its era: 1M-context input processing at Flash prices.
tradeoff: Shutdown is scheduled and Gemini 3.6 Flash replaces it outright — plan the migration now.
